items.title: Lawmakers want to ban VPNs
items.raw_content: It's unfortunately no longer enough to force websites to check your government-issued ID before you can access certain content, because politicians have now discovered that people are using Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) to protect their privacy and bypass these invasive laws. Their solution? Entirely ban the use of VPNs.
items.title_zh: 议员们想封禁 VPN
items.summary: An EFF article argues that lawmakers, having found that people use VPNs to protect their privacy and bypass government ID checks, are now pushing to ban VPNs outright.

items.title: Go's Sweet 16
items.raw_content: This past Monday, November 10th, we celebrated the 16th anniversary of Go’s open source release ! We released Go 1.24 in February and Go 1.25 in August , following our now well-established and dependable release cadence. Continuing our mission to build the most productive language platform for building production systems, these releases included new APIs for building robust and reliable software, significant advances in Go’s track record for building secure software, and some serious under-the-hood improvements. Meanwhile, no one can ignore the seismic shifts in our industry brought by generative AI. The Go team is applying its thoughtful and uncompromising mindset to the problems and opportunities of this dynamic space, working to bring Go’s production-ready approach to building robust AI integrations, products, agents, and infrastructure.
items.title_zh: Go 开源 16 周年
items.summary: The Go team marked the 16th anniversary of Go's open-source release on November 10, noting that Go 1.24 shipped in February and Go 1.25 in August. The post cites new APIs, security advances, and under-the-hood improvements, and says the team is bringing Go's production-ready approach to AI integrations, products, agents, and infrastructure.
